jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:IT Application Manager/inStellenbeschreibung:ENGIE Germany stands for combined expertise in the transition to climate neutrality, offering comprehensive energy solutions and services ranging from plant engineering to carbon neutrality. More than 5,500 employees at 50 locations are already making a real difference when it comes to climate neutrality.  How do we do that? For example, we develop and implement sustainable solutions in the areas of wind, solar, hydro, and energy storage. Or we plan and build process facilities for our customers in the energy and utilities sectors. Or we provide technical building management support for heating, plumbing, HVAC, and refrigeration systems. And so on. As you can see, we’re shaping the future of energy - together.   Your tomorrow starts today! Join us in welcoming the future and become part of our success as IT Application Manager Robotron eSales (m/f/d)**Location:** Berlin or Cologne**Reference number:** 65000We are looking for an experienced and proactive IT Application Manager for our EDM system eSales from Robotron. In this role, you will enable the business to use the EDM system efficiently, as well as manage the whole application and it’s interfaces.As the central expert for robotron eSales, you will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external vendors to maintain high availability, optimize processes, and drive digital excellence.Your responsibilities:Application Ownership & Operations- Serve as the primary application expert and strategic product owner for Robotron eSales, driving the product vision and roadmap- Ensure stable, secure, and reliable daily operation of the solution, including incident, problem, and change management- Coordinate maintenance, upgrades, and integrations in line with IT standardsBusiness Support & Enhancement- Act as the key interface between business and technical teams- Analyze business requirements, prioritize the product backlog, and translate them into technical specifications or user stories- Manage enhancements, configurations, and system optimizations to support evolving business needs and maximize business valueProject & Vendor Management- Lead or contribute to digitalization and automation initiatives leveraging Robotron eSales- Take ownership of vendor management by effectively managing relationships with Robotron and other external service providers to ensure SLA fulfillment and timely feature delivery- Support implementation projects, testing, and release cyclesQuality, Security & Compliance- Ensure data quality, system documentation, and audit readiness- Promote adherence to IT security, data protection, and compliance standardsYour profile:- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience- Several years of proven experience as a Product Owner or Application Manager specifically with Robotron eSalesGood understanding of German and/or European energy market processes (e.g., billing, EDM, market communication)- Hands-on knowledge of: - SQL databases- Interfaces/API concepts (EDIFACT, AS4, REST)- Application lifecycle management- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive, customer-oriented approach- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively align with business leaders and external vendors- Fluent in German and EnglishWhat We Offer You:- **EXCITING EXTRAS:** Discounts, e-bikes, services, and technology from leading providers via our ENGIE platform.  - **FAMILY AND CAREER:** Up to 150 € toward childcare or preschool fees.  - **FLEXIBLE WORK:** At ENGIE, you get the flexibility you need to successfully complete your tasks.- **MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR POTENTIAL:** Training sessions, workshops, and continuing education—do what helps you and us grow.    - **YOUR PERFECT PLACE:** We support your internal transition to other divisions within ENGIE. We Embrace DiversityAt ENGIE, we are convinced that every talent plays an important role in accelerating the energy transition. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment where diversity is valued and each individual is supported.  Our goal is to create a culture of collaboration and innovation where every employee can thrive and reach their full potential. We actively welcome applications that contribute to the diversity of our company. Every talent is welcome here—and, above all, valued equally! Regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or disability.  **HELLO TOMORROW!** Your tomorrow starts today! Become part of our success with excellent career prospects and high recognition. Join us in shaping the transition to climate neutrality. We look forward to receiving your online application.   **Your contact:**  Stefanie Holscher BlackmanTalent Acquisition Partner  Recruiting Hotline: +49 30 915810344

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoptionWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environmentAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Process Operator (f/m/d)Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, GermanyStart date: ASAPContract type: Full-timeAbout usWe’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.The roleIn this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production.
